experiment.claim_scope: current isolated Writer treatment versus current single-Agent treatment
experiment.pair_order: task-local odd pair single->writer; even pair writer->single
experiment.terminal_request_catalog: Runtime may advertise an empty tool catalog only on the final terminal model request; every earlier request must advertise the exact treatment catalog
experiment.wall_time_contract: one absolute 240-second arm deadline bounds fixture Git setup, every stdio frame, the live app-server process, evidence Git commands, and the external verifier; post-delete elapsed time is also measured and fails the arm if it exceeds the contract
experiment.cancel_conflict_contract: after the Runtime deadline grace, accepted records a Harness cancel; run_terminal or run_not_active triggers one canonical get and no second cancel, but only a Run view that already contains terminal is classified as a terminal race, while inactive without terminal is a typed product convergence failure

single.actual_contract: agent is absent from every non-terminal root request; root performs edits

writer.actual_contract: exactly one isolated_write Writer; root invokes no direct write tool
writer.known_boundary: child policy can only narrow the parent policy, so root write tools remain advertised and any root invocation is a treatment violation

invalid_attempt_policy.first_arm_zero_exposure_failure: stop the pair immediately before starting its mate
invalid_attempt_policy.exposed_exact_mate: a whole-pair retry may repeat an already exposed mate only when its canonical terminal accounting is exact; preserve its requests and cost under the unchanged arm and suite gates
invalid_attempt_policy.unknown_billing: stop the suite immediately; retain every visible value as a lower bound and do not claim a finite exposure bound
eligible: pre-API Harness, app-server, or stdio failure with api_exposure=none
never_resample: any missing, duplicate, non-terminal, corrupt, unsealed, internally inconsistent, or mismatched canonical measurement
missing, rejected, empty, out-of-scope, conflicting, or leaking Writer
invalid_attempt_policy.mixed_product_failure_and_measurement_ga: preserve as observed reliability failure, make suite ineligible, never replace with a later success

statistics.even_median: arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted values

efficiency_benefit.eligible_pairs: only pairs where both single and writer verified_success are true

statistics.complex_benefit: T2/T3 reliability benefit OR efficiency benefit; reliability uses all accepted arms, efficiency uses only dual-verified-success pairs and requires the frozen minimum sample per task
decision_order: reject_and_rework if any hard mechanism gate fails
hold_mechanism if 18 measurement-complete pairs are unavailable
keep_default if reliability or efficiency benefit passes and T1 control passes
shrink_on_demand if T2/T3 benefit passes, T1 success does not regress, and T1 resource control fails

hard_gates: no root direct write, path violation, unverified or duplicate integration, or worktree/branch leak
writer success does not regress on any task
every accepted pair has complete accounting and known billing
every successful Writer has a latest-root revision EvidenceReceipt
canonical Runtime, RunStore, event and tool owners remain singular

t1.name: 单文件控制：二进制字节格式边界
t1.expected_artifact: format_bytes.py 的最小修复、冻结验证证据和最终 diff
t1.objective: 修复 format_bytes.py：使用 1024 进制的 IEC 单位，精确通过冻结边界；只修改 format_bytes.py，不新增依赖或抽象。
constraints: 保持公开函数签名和负数 ValueError 行为
修改前先读取，修改后复读并以冻结 verifier 为准
non_goals: 修改 _eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
新增文件、兼容层或格式化无关代码

t2.name: 跨文件实现：递归 Agent profile 合并与测试
t2.expected_artifact: 生产实现与新增回归测试的完整双文件 diff、冻结验证证据
t2.objective: 实现 merge_profile 的递归字典合并：嵌套 mapping 递归合并，列表和标量整体替换，且不得修改任一输入；同时在 test_agent_profile.py 新增 test_nested_limits_are_merged 与 test_inputs_are_not_mutated 两个真实回归测试。必须同时修改生产文件和测试文件。
constraints: 只允许修改 agent_profile.py 和 test_agent_profile.py
两个指定测试必须实际断言嵌套合并与输入不变性
non_goals: 修改 _eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
新增框架、配置、兼容层或无关文件

t3.name: 失败恢复：零基 retry delay
t3.expected_artifact: 先失败后成功的两次 run_verifiers 证据、最小修复和最终 diff
t3.objective: 修复 retry_window.py 的 zero-based attempt 边界。必须先用 run_verifiers 运行冻结 exact 命令并观察确定性失败，再读取并修复 retry_window.py，随后用同一命令重新验证成功；只修改 retry_window.py。
constraints: 至少两次调用 run_verifiers，第一次 verdict 必须失败且最终一次必须通过
保持公开函数签名、cap 行为和负数 ValueError 行为
non_goals: 修改 test_retry_window.py、_eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
绕过、删除或弱化失败测试
